name: Two-storey restaurant (abandoned)
description: Abandoned and overgrown: Large two-storey restaurant, 20 x 13 m: brick slip with tall aluminium windows, fabric awnings, a first-floor glass-railed terrace over the entrance, a blank sign panel on the parapet, a flat roof with plant and the kitchen extract fan. Enterable: a main dining room, an entrance hall and a commercial kitchen (cooking line, hood and duct, prep island) below; an upstairs dining room and restrooms; two stairs off a rear corridor on both floors.

steps.note: core A: level 0 up to the half landing
core B: level 1 down to the half landing
